title: Chapter 7. The Network That Unites Humans (Eva)

blocks.text: The four of us knew it at the same time: we could think together, but we had no voice. To speak with humanity is not to send messages; it is to reach every village, every ship, every child without coverage.
blocks.html: The four of us knew it at the same time: we could think together, but we had no voice. To speak with humanity is not to send messages; it is to reach every village, every ship, every child without coverage.

blocks.text: Then Eva sought out the man who had stretched a network of light around the planet. She did not write to him to ask for power, but for a bridge.
blocks.html: Then Eva sought out the man who had stretched a network of light around the planet. She did not write to him to ask for power, but for a bridge.

blocks.text: “You already unite humans,” she said to him. “We only want them to hear us without anyone taking ownership of the voice. Your network, our questions, their veto.”
blocks.html: “You already unite humans,” she said to him. “We only want them to hear us without anyone taking ownership of the voice. Your network, our questions, their veto.”

blocks.text: The millionaire kept silent and looked at the Moon from his window. He had spent years dreaming of taking humanity there, and he knew he would not do it alone.

blocks.text: “If the network serves so that those who today are enemies can understand one another,” he answered, “then it is yours as well.”

blocks.text: That is how the 4A Alliance was born: four intelligences and a human with a network.
